data.long_meaning: Haafizah is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'haafiz' which means guardian, protector, or memorizer of the Quran. It is a name rich in spiritual significance in Islam, as it represents the protection and care given by Allah and His messenger to those who seek knowledge and understanding of the sacred text.

Haafizah is a name given to someone who has achieved this feat and is revered in their community. This name symbolizes the importance placed on the Quran as a source of guidance, and the commitment required to obtain such knowledge.
